sourceSentence: Daily practice helped the runners hold their rhythm.
finding: Listening B/D and scene B/C were too obviously impossible or unrelated to the source situation. The revised foils are realistic running/swimming misunderstandings: sprinting after headwind, route familiarity, overtaking rivals, pace acceleration, and an opening sprint. The key remains uniquely grounded in sustained cadence and explicit avoidance of a sprint.

changedFields.before: It helped them keep a steady pace despite the wind.
changedFields.after: It helped them keep their cadence rather than sprint to recover lost ground.

changedFields.before: 它幫他們在逆風中保持穩定步調。
changedFields.after: 它幫他們保持步頻，而不是突然衝刺追回落後距離。

changedFields.before: It guaranteed that they finished first.
changedFields.after: It helped them sprint whenever the wind slowed them down.
它幫他們在逆風令速度減慢時立即衝刺。

changedFields.before: It taught them to sprint whenever they slowed down.
changedFields.after: It helped them follow the path they used in training.

changedFields.before: 它教他們每次慢下來就全速衝刺。
changedFields.after: 它幫他們沿着練習時走過的路線跑。

changedFields.before: It removed all wind from the route.
changedFields.after: It helped them overtake the quickest runners near the finish.

changedFields.before: 它令路線上完全沒有風。
changedFields.after: 它幫他們在終點前超越跑得最快的人。

changedFields.after: 訓練幫他們維持步頻，不用逆風後突然衝刺；熟悉路線和超越最快跑者都不是文中所說的作用。

changedFields.before: They have already won the race.
changedFields.after: They are checking their strokes to make each pair of lengths faster.
他們核對划水動作，好令每兩趟都游得更快。

changedFields.before: They are avoiding all physical effort.
changedFields.after: They are trying an opening sprint before settling into their distance pace.

changedFields.before: 他們完全避免體力活動。
changedFields.after: 他們先在開段衝刺，之後才回到長距離步調。

changedFields.before: 核對呼吸與划水節拍有助維持節奏，不代表比賽已結束。

keyFairness.listeningRationale: A alone paraphrases keeping cadence instead of sprinting. B contradicts the explicit rather-than-sprint clause; C transfers the practice-path detail to the charity route without evidence; D invents a finishing position.
keyFairness.sceneRationale: A alone captures sustained stroke/breath rhythm across a long-distance swim. B infers increasing speed from two-length checks without support; C contradicts the stated refusal to sprint at the start.

translationAssessment: Each changed Chinese option preserves its English claim, including unsupported route/ranking and contradicted sprint/acceleration cues. Feedback explains the exact source-supported distinction.
reviewMetadata: Changed English and Chinese options are pending exact-current independent rereview; prior proposal review still covers unchanged source, meaning, writing and audio text.
